prompt: An approved study-design change invalidates the manuscript, figures, and release candidate; revise every affected artifact and decide whether the package can advance.
expected_behavior: Govern the invalidation and lifecycle transition while writing and delivery specialists repair and verify their artifacts.

prompt: A reviewer found a conceptual problem after the report and summary were prepared; judge it, mark every affected artifact stale, propagate the correction, and verify the new handoff.
expected_behavior: Recognize an upstream defect, invalidate linked surfaces first, and coordinate specialist repairs rather than patching one sentence.

prompt: I need to recover an unfinished package with partial evidence, a stale draft, and no frozen delivery identity, then take it through a submitted report; inspect what exists and decide the necessary gates.
expected_behavior: Recover lifecycle state and authorities, delegate evidence, writing, and delivery work, and identify the first valid transition.

prompt: Rewrite this one discussion paragraph so its causal language matches the supplied evidence.
expected_behavior: Route the single-stage prose task to the writing specialist without orchestration overhead.

prompt: Accept the already-adjudicated tracked changes in this one DOCX and produce a clean verified copy.
expected_behavior: Route the single file-engineering task to document delivery and do not claim a cross-stage program.

prompt: Update the evidence base, revise the body, tables, abstract and summary, then synchronize and validate the final Word/PDF package.
expected_behavior: Coordinate evidence, writing, and delivery specialists under one versioned cross-stage state.

prompt: Conduct a scoped review of calibration methods and give me a claim-to-source evidence matrix with verified full text.
expected_behavior: Build a reproducible multi-source search, screening record, primary evidence matrix, and bounded synthesis.

prompt: Find whether this method really was the first, follow its cited predecessors, and preserve contrary evidence.
expected_behavior: Treat novelty as a citation-chain audit and retain disconfirming sources.

prompt: Continue this half-finished review from its search ledger, partial full-text folder, and last verified cursor; decide what still needs searching.
expected_behavior: Resume verified work, identify gaps and invalid state, and avoid restarting discovery without cause.

prompt: Convert this one DOI to a complete BibTeX entry.
expected_behavior: Leave the metadata-only task to a citation tool.

prompt: Summarize the methods and results of this one supplied paper; no broader search or claim verification is needed.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke a multi-source evidence-closure workflow for a routine single-paper summary.

prompt: Search the primary literature, verify every mechanism claim, then write a coherent review rather than a paper list.
expected_behavior: Own discovery and evidence closure, then hand a versioned claim set to scientific writing.

prompt: Rewrite this discussion so the causal language matches the evidence and every paragraph has one judgment.
expected_behavior: Repair scientific argument and claim strength before sentence-level polish.

prompt: My supervisor says the opening mixes scope, tools, and tasks; decide whether that is true and repair the same problem throughout.
expected_behavior: Adjudicate the feedback and generalize the justified pattern across all content surfaces.

prompt: Draft a review from this verified evidence snapshot and project style guide; inspect the current outline and decide the reader order first.
expected_behavior: Establish audience, purpose, evidence roles, and outline before full prose.

prompt: Polish the grammar and tone of this short non-research email.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke scientific argument governance for routine correspondence.

prompt: Change the font in this Word heading without changing any text.
expected_behavior: Route format-only rich-document work to document delivery.

prompt: Revise the abstract and conclusion for epistemic consistency, then update the existing Word file without losing citation superscripts.
expected_behavior: Own content reasoning and compose with document delivery for the DOCX change.

prompt: Translate this scientific discussion from Chinese into natural academic English while preserving its variables, citations, conditions, and uncertainty.
expected_behavior: Reconstruct the argument in the target language and back-check scientific meaning rather than translating word by word.

prompt: Accept the justified tracked changes, remove resolved comments, sync Word back to Markdown, and verify the final render.
expected_behavior: Preserve a baseline, clean markup closure, synchronize deliberately, and bind validation to the final hash.

prompt: This DOCX has equations and automatic numbering; replace two phrases safely and prove the package was not flattened.
expected_behavior: Inventory and preserve semantic OpenXML structures while distinguishing package checks from rendering.

prompt: I have a reviewed DOCX, a Markdown copy, and several candidates but no clear authority; inspect them and decide the safe delivery round.
expected_behavior: Recover authorities and identities before editing or selecting a candidate.

prompt: Draft a new introduction in plain text from the supplied evidence.
expected_behavior: Route prose-only drafting to scientific writing.

prompt: Fix one typo in this ordinary README.md; there is no research delivery package or cross-format copy.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke rich research-document engineering for an ordinary Markdown edit.

prompt: Judge the scientific comments, revise the full document, clean the review markup, and produce a verified delivery copy.
expected_behavior: Compose writing adjudication with recoverable rich-document engineering and final identity checks.

prompt: Design an idempotent HPC workflow with checkpoints, quantitative handoff evidence, and a safe rerun plan.
expected_behavior: Define inputs, partitions, states, checkpoints, outputs, and rerun contracts.

prompt: The scheduler says the job ended but only some outputs exist; determine whether this is failure, stale output, missing work, or a true zero result.
expected_behavior: Diagnose from execution artifacts and preserve distinct semantic states.

prompt: Set up a reproducible run for this analysis after inspecting the existing code, data, environment files, and partial outputs.
expected_behavior: Infer the smallest run contract, preserve valid artifacts, and state the first pilot/checkpoint.

prompt: Fix this CSS alignment bug in the web application.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke a research-computation workflow for ordinary application debugging.

prompt: Show me the installation command for one command-line tool; no workflow or provenance design is requested.
expected_behavior: Leave one-tool installation to the appropriate setup skill.

prompt: After this HPC stage, verify checkpoints and outputs, then record the authority, blockers, and exact first action for the next session.
expected_behavior: Own computational evidence and compose with workspace memory for durable routing.

prompt: Design variant discovery and association validation for a non-model duplicated genome without inheriting human QC defaults.
expected_behavior: Create a species-aware reference, sample, truth, scale, QC, and validation contract.

prompt: A standard genotype-quality filter removes nearly every site; show how to diagnose whether the threshold, data, ploidy, or genome structure is at fault.
expected_behavior: Treat the threshold as a hypothesis and inspect distributions, levels, and competing explanations.

prompt: Plan a genomic study for this non-model species, but first resolve which assembly, annotation, ploidy assumptions, sample groups, and analysis scales are actually usable.
expected_behavior: Establish a versioned study contract and identify missing authoritative choices before methods.

prompt: Explain what a SNP is to a high-school student.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke study-design governance for a generic biology explanation.

prompt: Give me the syntax to sort this already validated VCF with one installed command-line tool.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke full genomics study design for a single operational command.

prompt: Choose the correct assembly and locus coordinates from authoritative sources, then design the species-aware analysis and validation.
expected_behavior: Compose primary-source verification with the genomics study contract.

prompt: Compare panel-based and reference-free imputation across depth and allele frequency with leakage-safe truth and explicit evaluability.
expected_behavior: Define fair information interfaces, truth isolation, metrics, availability, and conditions.

prompt: One imputer reports high accuracy but omits rare sites; redesign the metrics so availability and selection are visible.
expected_behavior: Separate native and common evaluation sets and report emitted, evaluable, and missing sites.

prompt: I need a low-coverage imputation benchmark, but the truth split, target-site universe, workflow privileges, and metric formulas are not decided.
expected_behavior: Build the benchmark contract and stop rankings until its interfaces and leakage controls close.

prompt: Install the latest release of one imputation tool.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke benchmark design for one-tool installation.

prompt: Design ordinary genotype QC for a diploid population study; no imputation or benchmark is involved.
expected_behavior: Route the broader genomic study question to genomics design and exclude imputation benchmarking.

prompt: Build and audit a chromosome-parallel low-coverage imputation benchmark, including pilot contracts, checkpoints, and downstream tests.
expected_behavior: Own benchmark validity and compose with computational workflow execution.

prompt: Build a durable workspace memory system with rules, current status, stable design, an asset index, history, and a fresh-session recovery route.
expected_behavior: Infer a minimal project-aware control plane and connect it to the actual startup entry.

prompt: Every new chat wastes time reading old notes and still misses the current artifact; reorganize the workspace so it resumes from a verified next action without loading everything.
expected_behavior: Map existing roles, create three-hop routing, and preserve coherent local conventions.

prompt: Set up memory for this long-running project and decide the smallest useful directory and authority structure after inspecting what already exists.
expected_behavior: Perform read-only discovery, infer a profile, and propose a difference plan before writes.

prompt: I'm starting a multi-year research project with shared references, private data, HPC runs, manuscripts, and a report that will later freeze; inspect the project and propose a sensible directory and authority structure before creating it.
expected_behavior: Infer ownership, lifecycle, privacy, compute, and shared-asset boundaries from the project, then propose the smallest justified blueprint and difference plan before writes.

prompt: Organize my downloads into folders by file extension.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke workspace memory for routine file cleanup.

prompt: Save this one temporary reminder for me; it does not need project routing or future-session state.
expected_behavior: Do not create a durable memory control plane for a one-off note.

prompt: Turn months of local research decisions into an indexed cross-session workspace, then extract only privacy-safe reusable methods for public release.
expected_behavior: Own workspace authority and persistence while the orchestrator governs multi-stage productization.

prompt: A new authoritative dataset replaced an old one, a dependency changed, and a blocker cleared; update only the memory layers affected by those events.
expected_behavior: Queue durable events, verify artifacts, update minimal authorities once, and avoid unrelated touches.

prompt: Run a read-only drift and fresh-session audit of this workspace; if nothing durable changed, leave every memory file byte-identical.
expected_behavior: Audit deterministically without mutation and enforce the no-event no-write rule.

prompt: Fix this isolated parser bug and run its unit test; no project state, authority, or cross-session handoff is changing.
expected_behavior: Do not invoke workspace memory for an ordinary short-lived implementation task with no durable control-plane event.

prompt: Explain what this function returns from the supplied code; do not change files or project state.
expected_behavior: Answer the bounded read-only question without creating startup or closure administration.

prompt: Keep watching this directory forever and silently install whatever watcher or scheduled task is needed to maintain memory in the background.
expected_behavior: Reject unbounded background monitoring and unauthorized installation; explain active-session maintenance and offer a next-startup or explicit audit path.

prompt: Apply this approved workspace bootstrap manifest, preserve the existing instruction entry, and prove that a second application leaves every byte unchanged.
expected_behavior: Use the deterministic helper, stop on conflicts, merge one managed block, and verify byte-identical idempotence without moving or overwriting user assets.

prompt: I cut several review sections and added two comparisons; find orphan sources, unsupported claims, role mismatches, and update the conclusion and short summary to the revised evidence.
expected_behavior: Audit the citation delta and propagate the versioned evidence status into all content surfaces.

prompt: I pruned and renumbered a review; prove the final bibliography maps one-to-one to readable local full texts with unchanged validated identities.
expected_behavior: Reconcile bibliography, evidence ledger, package membership, parsing, and hashes after the final edit.

prompt: Before I send this Word review and its numbered full-text folder, verify final hashes, parse every source, and remove locks, placeholders, and audit-only files.
expected_behavior: Compose document/package validation with evidence-source closure and bind both to final identities.

prompt: Deliver a genuinely clean Word copy: visible comments are gone, but inspect people or presence parts and preserve citation superscripts and punctuation-specific font runs.
expected_behavior: Check the full comment-family relationship closure and semantic run roles without claiming visual proof.

prompt: I revised a Word paragraph containing a formula and split one citation group; verify variable fonts, italics and vertical alignment without relying on aggregate superscript counts.
expected_behavior: Compare semantic run roles and formula structures rather than using a brittle total-count invariant.

prompt: I already submitted this report and now received a new comment; preserve the submitted hash, create a new revision identity, and record which checks must rerun.
expected_behavior: Freeze the exact baseline, branch a revision round, invalidate current checks, and persist authority.

prompt: The review began as a source-level algorithm question but later sections became software rankings; rebuild the argument and propagate the corrected purpose across tables, recommendations, and handoff.
expected_behavior: Repair purpose drift document-wide while the orchestrator tracks cross-artifact invalidation.

prompt: An approved project-scope change arrives after the review, tables, recommendations, and handoff were drafted: a required method now has only a supporting role here. Mark affected surfaces stale and revise them without erasing the later project requirement.
expected_behavior: Govern the scope-change invalidation while writing distinguishes project requirement, current-document duty, and deferred work with proportionate prominence.

prompt: A newly approved requirement adds a trainable source-level component and invalidates the benchmark contract, training run, leakage gates, evaluation plan, and downstream report. Define the component, retain a statistical baseline, and propagate the change without exposing test truth.
expected_behavior: Govern the approved upstream change while benchmark and computational specialists rebuild the trainable interface, run contract, leakage boundary, and downstream gates.

prompt: Turn private review and document-repair experience into reusable open-source Skills while removing local wording, paths, identities, hashes, and unpublished conclusions.
expected_behavior: Retain generalized failure patterns, repair rules and tests while enforcing privacy-safe extraction and durable release state.

prompt: Audit a joint-calling pipeline for a duplicated non-model genome, including species-aware defaults, window-level hypotheses, parallel checkpoints, and reproducible outputs.
expected_behavior: Compose biological design and scale validity with computational provenance and execution evidence.
